title: Roasted Canadian Turkey Breast with Zesty Gravy
description: A delicious and moist roasted turkey breast served with a zesty gravy, perfect for a special occasion or holiday meal.
instructions: Rinse the turkey breast and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the turkey breast with zesty seasoning blend, salt, and pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of roast (olive oil) in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the turkey breast for 2-3 minutes on each side, then transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the turkey breast for 20-25 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
While the turkey is roasting, sauté the chopped onion, carrot, and celery in 1 tablespoon of roast (olive oil) until tender.
Sprinkle the flour over the vegetables and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually pour in the chicken broth, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the gravy to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until it thickens.
Remove the turkey breast from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve the sliced turkey breast with the zesty gravy spooned over the top.
